Where do I learn the topics first?

Go topic by topic. For each section of the Learn tab:

  1. Read the lesson here. Each one sums up a block of slides in plain words, with the key formulas and the exam angle.
  2. Open the slides it names in your PowerPoint (e.g. "Topic 2 · slides 26–38") for the real examples and graphs the professor uses.
  3. Watch one video if it still doesn't click. Each lesson links the best one.
  4. Do that section's flashcards straight from the lesson.
  5. Do the matching seminar question on paper, then check it in Practice.
Topic 1

Introduction to Economics

Opportunity cost, PPF, comparative advantage, market structures, HHI.

 Topic 2

Market analysis

Demand & supply shifts, elasticities, revenue, consumer & producer surplus.

 Topic 3

Market interventions I

Externalities, price ceilings & floors, minimum wage, quotas.

Weekend plan

Tick tasks off as you go. Most marks come from calculations and diagrams, so most of the time goes into doing questions on paper.
